scenes.pedagogical_objective: Teacher introduces the daily counting drill using colloquial classroom Hinglish / Hindi to engage Grade 1 tribal learners.

scenes.scene_name: Dual-Script Classroom Board & Ten-Frame Numeracy Visualizer
scenes.pedagogical_objective: Reinforce mathematical quantity association by linking Hindi numerals, Mundari number words, and visual counter beads (Ten-Frame).
scenes.visual_setup: Screen recording of Bhasha Setu 'Numeracy Bridge' module alongside physical bead-frame on teacher's desk.

actor_action.speaker: Teacher
actor_action.action: Points to numbers 1 through 10 on the screen as students choral chant the Mundari numbers: 'मिअद (1), बारिया (2), आपिया (3)... गेलेया (10)'.
actor_action.spoken_dialogue: देखिये, स्क्रीन पर भी आ गया: मिअद (1) से गेलेया (10) तक।

ui_interaction.screen_action: Teacher taps number beads 1 to 10; UI highlights the synchronized Devanagari Mundari numerals and counters.

scenes.caption_callout: Culturally responsive numeracy: bridging regional numeral cognition with native counting lexicon (मिअद to गेलेया).

scenes.pedagogical_objective: Demonstrate two-way communication where tribal students express their recitation in Mundari and the system verifies comprehension in Hindi.
scenes.visual_setup: Close-up of student speaking into tablet microphone, followed by instantaneous reverse translation on the teacher's monitor.

actor_action.speaker: Student (Raj Kumar)
actor_action.action: Student answers in Mundari that he will count: 'नअःदो अइंग लेकायाइंग गेलबर जकेद्।' (Now I will count up to twelve.)
